authoritative_for: Platter owns captured inputs, brief and Jackson-bullet preparation, private pursuit assessment, accepted stages, rendered resumes, dated editions, opportunity exclusions and recorded email outcomes. Each ad hoc test retains its own frozen payload and receipt without changing normal packet sent history.
not_authoritative_for: Cast owns discovery records. CRM owns career entries. Employer endpoints supply posting text. Nucleus owns execution. Email and Resend own submission acceptance. Gmail owns final receipt.

covers: All Platter CLI outcomes for initialization, preparation, normal and ad hoc edition preview, explicit send, local status, readiness, maintenance and schema-compatible installation in this source release.
excludes: Help/version, production scheduling, automatic application submission, employer contact, CRM writes and final inbox delivery observation.

shared_access_and_trust: The current-user CLI operates private state. Models receive only captured source material and narrow requester tools. The installer publishes only Platter-owned command and provider selectors through Cell coordinated maintenance. A source bundle alone establishes neither an installed command nor send authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Original resume, captured CRM entries, posting text, model inputs/results, evidence references, PDFs, editions and send outcomes are private retained data. Nucleus/model processing receives career material; explicit send discloses the brief and resume attachments to Email, Resend and Gmail.
compatibility_and_retirement: Package/provider release 0.1.1, capability contract versions and private state schema 1 are distinct. Brief contract 2 introduces structured submissions while retaining v1 requests and outputs; stored brief text and frozen editions keep their existing shape and bytes. The predecessor job-packets state remains in place and retains immutable execution and email identities; unsupported schemas are refused. No template replacement or incompatible state rollback is provided.
operational_limits: Each edition contains up to three new ready packets. There is no candidate or token budget. Jobs use gpt-5.6-sol at max effort. The stored 09:00 America/Chicago setting does not install or enable a schedule. Check source, runtime and rendering readiness separately.
